_comment: How an asteroid ends an Age (design 5.3). `timeline` is each stage in ticks once the end is bought: three
in-game days of approach from the bind, then the entry, the travel, the heat and the dust.
`inflicted_when` is when the Age's own instability calls it down unasked; a word naming the `asteroid`
phenomenon calls it down whatever this says. A condition is one of: `reach` (how far into a manifestation,
or one of its dials, from 0 to 1), `flaws` (at least so many distinct flaws, of one `register` if named),
`tier` (the flaws reaching `strange`, `harmful` or `failing`), `chance` (one Age in `share`, from its seed),
and `all_of`, `any_of` and `not` over others. Left out, only a word calls it down.
For now, an Age whose collapse is at its fastest: `spread` bought in full.
